messages:
Sam: Hey @channel — PR https://github.com/redwoodinc/repo/pull/2931 is ready to land. Needs one more approval + CI green. We're in the rebase window 22:00-23:30 UTC and there's a deploy blackout starting 00:00 UTC. Quick summary: fixes autoscaling regression and includes a small, backward-compatible DB migration. Can someone give quick eyes?

Mira: Looking now. Running the flaky e2e locally to reproduce. If anyone sees the logs before I post, call it out.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #2931: linux-unit ✓, integration queued, mac-e2e ✗ (flaky). To rerun: use the GitHub Actions "Re-run jobs" button or run `/ci rerun 2931`.

Toni: @Sam quick note — there was a schema-lock tweak on main earlier. Please rebase onto main before we try again: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` should be enough. Ops prefers no schema-affecting migrations during the blackout window.

Ryan: I can give an approval once CI is green. If mac-e2e keeps flaking, we could land a canary to Dedicated then promote, but not ideal during blackout. Would prefer to wait for a clean run.

Mira: Rebased and pushed to `sam/pr-2931-rebased`. Kicked off a rerun: `/ci rerun 2931`. Will update in a minute.

ci-bot: Rerun started. mac-e2e failing again at `login_flow` step. Snippet from logs: ```TimeoutError: element not found after 30s
  at /workspace/tests/e2e/login_flow.spec.ts:42:15```

devops-bot: FYI — ops on-call (@Toni) can extend the rebase window to 23:45 UTC if we need a couple extra minutes, but the recommendation is to postpone non-critical DB changes until after blackout.

Sam: Ok — let's hold landing for now. If we get a clean run before 23:30 UTC, I'll coordinate a quick canary and ping @release. If not, we'll defer the PR until after the blackout. Adding `release/hold` label. Thanks for the quick eyes.

Mira: Ack :thumbsup:

Toni: I'll keep an eye on on-call in case you need the 23:45 extension.

Ryan: Thanks — ping me if you want a post-merge rollout plan for the canary path.
